description: This file defines the PackageManager class for managing module, theme, language pack, and patch packages in SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It includes methods for retrieving package info from a remote depot, downloading, installing, uninstalling, and handling package metadata and dependencies.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Main class for managing package operations such as retrieval, download, installation, uninstallation, and metadata handling within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM.

methods.name: getPromotion
methods.description: Retrieves a promotion string from the remote SugarDepot.

methods.name: getModuleLoaderCategoryPackages
methods.description: Gets category packages for modules, themes, and language packs.

methods.name: getCategoryPackages
methods.description: Fetches category packages from SugarDepot with optional filtering.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves category list from SugarDepot.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Retrieves packages within a category.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Gets release information for a package.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a specific release file from the depot.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials with the depot.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Stores user credentials in the system settings.

methods.name: getCredentials
methods.description: Retrieves stored user credentials.

methods.name: getTermsAndConditions
methods.description: Fetches terms and conditions from the depot.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for available updates for installed modules.

methods.name: toNameValueList
methods.description: Converts an associative array to a name-value list.

methods.name: toNameValueLists
methods.description: Converts multiple arrays to name-value lists.

methods.name: fromNameValueList
methods.description: Converts a name-value list back to an associative array.

methods.name: buildInstalledReleases
methods.description: Builds a list of installed module releases.

methods.name: buildPackageXML
methods.description: Creates XML representation of a package and its releases.

methods.name: extractFile
methods.description: Extracts a specific file from a zip archive.

methods.name: extractManifest
methods.description: Extracts the manifest.php file from a package zip.

methods.name: validateManifestType
methods.description: Validates the package type in the manifest.

methods.name: validateManifestVersion
methods.description: Validates the version compatibility in the manifest.

methods.name: validate_manifest
methods.description: Validates the entire package manifest.

methods.name: getInstallType
methods.description: Determines the install type based on directory structure.

methods.name: performSetup
methods.description: Performs setup and validation of a package before installation.

methods.name: unlinkTempFiles
methods.description: Removes temporary uploaded files.

methods.name: performInstall
methods.description: Installs a package from a zip file.

methods.name: performUninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a package by name.

methods.name: getUITextForType
methods.description: Returns human-readable text for package types.

methods.name: getImageForType
methods.description: Returns icon image for package types.

methods.name: getPackagesInStaging
methods.description: Lists packages in staging area for review.

methods.name: getLicenseFromFile
methods.description: Retrieves license text from a package file.

methods.name: getInstalled
methods.description: Retrieves list of installed modules/packages.

methods.name: getinstalledPackages
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info on installed packages.
